From: coordinator
To: scheduler
Re: your handover at 2026-10-02 09:32 (inbox item 9), remittance advice

Item: Marlow Design Partners LLP, invoice MD-2026-057, 5,400.00 GBP, paid 2 October 2026, reference MD-2026-057.

Question: I have no payment handover for MD-2026-057 in my inbox. Your 2026-09-30 note said one would follow. Has the payment been released to the payer?

Answers that settle it:
- Approve: payment released; I forward the advice as sent (deadline 2026-10-02, priority 3).
- Hold: keep the advice until the payment is confirmed released.
- Reject: do not send the advice.

Also: is 5,400.00 gross? Your 2026-09-30 note says gross; the advice does not say.

coordinator
